title: anthemis stiparum subsp. sabulicola
intro: Anthemis stiparum subsp. sabulicola, commonly known as a subspecies of the yarrow plant, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis stiparum subsp. sabulicola include its ability to soothe and calm the body, reducing stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
